question: Which covariance views of the selected v27 latent have a broad, sample-consistent magnitude hierarchy; what decoded image roles do their stable bands control; and does a trained prior recover those bands from known noisy real latents in the magnitude-predicted order?

scope.representation: selected v27 tokenizer seed 2, deterministic residual Perceiver, decoder jitter 0.05, slot balance 0.002, native 64x16 latent
scope.normalization: the prior checkpoint's tensor-wide population mean and standard deviation, followed by an elementwise training-population mean for covariance analysis

axes.channel: 16x16 covariance after averaging over samples and sequence positions; per-sample mode energy averages over all 64 tokens
axes.sequence: 64x64 covariance after averaging over samples and channels; per-sample mode energy averages over all 16 channels
axes.flattened: 1024x1024 covariance of vec(latent), retaining all token-channel interactions
axes.per_token: mean squared centered feature energy for each of the 64 native tokens; this is distinct as an explicit prior-facing grouping even though it is related to the sequence covariance diagonal

rank_bands.per_token: eight groups of eight native tokens, sorted only for the magnitude audit by descending population content power; original indices are retained

spectrum_shape: effective rank, stable rank, and head/tail ratios
sample_consistency: probability each population-ordered band exceeds the following band
per-sample rank correlation with the population mode order
measurements.factorization: best-scaled Frobenius residual and squared covariance cosine between the full covariance and channel/sequence marginal Kronecker product
measurements.decoded_roles: shuffle one latent band between held-out examples, preserving its marginal; report decoded delta RMS, RGB-mean change, Inception-feature change, and the radial FFT distribution of the decoded change
measurements.known_clean_denoising: noise held-out real latents at t=.1,.2,...,.9, predict their clean endpoints with the trained prior, and report relative MSE/correlation in every axis band plus decoded image, FFT, and Inception recovery against the known clean reconstruction

interpretation_rules: PCA rank order is definitional; a useful hierarchy additionally requires a nontrivial spectrum, samplewise band consistency, and a decoded or conditional role.
Single eigenvectors are not expected to preserve samplewise order. Decisions use predeclared bands and retain the full unbinned curves.
Decoder band swaps are model-specific interventions and can leave the joint latent manifold; local/small effects and agreement across examples are more credible than an isolated large ablation.
Known-clean noising separates analytic visibility, trained-denoiser recoverability, and decoded meaning without relying on a generated endpoint.

Native token scheduling is not justified when native-token magnitude order is weak or sample-inconsistent. In that case an ordered invertible readout or sequence/flattened eigenmode grouping is required first.
Factorized whitening is preferred only if it removes most full covariance structure and its resulting sequence bands have stable roles; otherwise flattened whitening is the scientific control.

No whitening prior or schedule/loss training launches in this phase. Any later factorial must compare common versus ordered time and uniform versus latent-derived tempered loss on the same frozen whitened cache.

existing_evidence.caveat: Existing channel consistency was computed per sample-token row rather than after aggregating channel-mode power within each sample; sequence-axis and decoded-role measurements are missing.
